name: city_bed
description: Leeway's city noise bed heard from the water (engine/audio/voices.hpp, CityNoise, its bed layer): a low rumble and traffic that swells and fades, for ONE listener distance at full loudness. The per-building distance sum (Leeway's cityPlacement), the zoom and the stereo placement stay game or adapter code, not this recipe; the horns and the ferry are separate sounds. No inputs: Leeway's bed has no game-driven parameter besides distance. Leeway's numbers: rumble noise low-passed at 140 Hz then 220 Hz, gain 1.8; traffic noise band-passed at 650 Hz, damping 1.2, gain 1.4 times a traffic level that heads for a new target in 0.2 .. 1 every 1.5 .. 4 s with smoothing 0.8 per second (time constant 1.25 s); then Leeway's city 0.8 and master 0.8 into tanh. Deviations: the traffic level is updated once per 128-sample control block, not per sample, and starts at 0.6 (mid-range) where Leeway starts at 0.5.
